text: Why don't skeletons fight? Because they have no guts.
What kind of tree fits in your hand? A palm tree.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
Why did the student eat the homework? The teacher said it was a piece of cake.
How do you make a tissue dance? You put a little boogie in it.
Why did the coffee call the police? It got mugged.
What did the ocean say to the beach? Nothing, it just waved.
Why did the tomato blush? It saw the salad dressing.
Why did the computer visit the doctor? It caught a virus.
Why couldn't the leopard hide? Because it was always spotted.
Why was the musician locked outside? It lost its keys.
Why was the math book sad? It had too many problems.
Why did the elephant bring a suitcase? It needed a trunk.
Why did the dog chase the tree? It heard its bark.
What kind of music do balloons hate? Pop.
Why did the chef go to the bank? To get some dough.
Why did the baseball player bring string? To tie the score.
Why did the painter wear two coats? The second was a coat of paint.
Why did the calendar get nervous? Its days were numbered.
What has an eye but cannot see? A needle.
